observations: Industrial flatbed sewing machine head mounted on a metal stand with a white tabletop.
Clutch-type motor assembly visible underneath the table in all photos.
Foot pedal, power cord, and a separate small stapler-like press device sit on the floor, cords loose and tangled.
Thread cones (yellow, maroon, pink, dark) placed on a thread stand; bobbins, scissors and small tools scattered on the table surface.
A brand name appears printed on the machine arm and on the table edge (photos 1 and 2) but resolution is too low to read clearly; no serial/model plate is visible in any shot.
No photo shows accessories laid out, a manual, or the machine running/stitching a sample.
Floor and surrounding area show general workshop clutter; no close-up of wiring terminals or motor nameplate.
Seller's new message is text only, reasserting prior claims; no new photo or video was provided.
